description: Neutral, cited explainer for ONE candidate contest on a local ballot. Never recommend a candidate. Describe; do not evaluate.

contest_name.description: Contest name exactly as printed on the official sample ballot, e.g. 'City of Walnut Creek, Member, City Council'.

jurisdiction.description: Government body the office belongs to, e.g. 'City of Walnut Creek'.

vote_for.description: How many candidates a voter may select in this contest, from the official ballot.

is_contested.description: True if there are more qualified candidates than seats.

what_the_office_controls.description: 2-3 plain-language sentences (8th-grade reading level) on what this office actually decides: budgets, land use, schools, water, etc. Cite official city/county/state sources where possible.

term_length.description: Length of the term, e.g. '4 years'. Null if not found in an authoritative source.

candidates.description: Every qualified candidate on the official candidate list for this contest, in ballot order.

name.description: Name as printed on the ballot.

ballot_designation.description: Occupation/ballot designation as printed, e.g. 'Small Business Owner'. Null if not found.

is_incumbent.description: True if currently holds this office. Null if unclear.

stated_priorities.description: Up to 3 priorities in the candidate's OWN words, paraphrased neutrally, each attributed (e.g. 'Says she will ...'). Only from the candidate's official statement, campaign site, or a published forum/interview. Empty array if none found.

official_statement_url.description: URL of the candidate statement in the county voter guide, if available.

neutral_summary.description: One neutral paragraph a first-time voter can read in 20 seconds. No adjectives that praise or criticize any candidate. No recommendation.
